title: Rahman breaks silence on criticism for 'Mangal Rang' from Ramayana'
description: In light of the diverse reactions to 'Mangal Rang', a track from 'Ramayana: Rise of a Legend', AR Rahman has shared his perspective on the subject. He pointed out that the journey of crafting music inevitably demands patience and self-reflection. Rahman emphasized the necessity of confidence in his artistic choices, quoting Steve Jobs to illustrate the aim for public approval.

title: Zendaya-Tom Holland buy a £9 million Wimbledon home with a private tennis court
description: Zendaya and Tom Holland have reportedly purchased a £9 million property in Wimbledon, featuring a private tennis court, sprawling garden and separate cottage. According to The Daily Mail, the house is located near the All England Club but could face a neighbourhood development dispute over proposed plans for a major tennis facility on adjoining land.

title: SRK sneaks out for a late-night drive to see ‘King’ tribute on sea link ahead of 61st birthday
description: Shah Rukh Khan's birthday on November 2 has generated excitement across the country among his fans. A special tribute to his upcoming film, 'King', was showcased in Mumbai recently. Speculation suggests that a teaser for 'King' may be unveiled on his birthday at Mannat. Additionally, fans are traveling to celebrate the occasion, including a large event organized in Pune.

title: 'Ramayana' advance box office: Film crosses Rs 36 cr, falls behind Yash's Toxic
description: Nitesh Tiwari's 'Ramayana: Part 1' has accumulated Rs 23.87 crore in advance bookings prior to its release. The film has sold over 5.42 lakh tickets across 13,165 shows, leading to significant occupancy rates. Notably, the movie is performing well in international markets with pre-sales exceeding $3.5 million. However, it is currently lagging behind 'Toxic: A Fairy Tale for Grown-Ups' in advance bookings numbers.

title: Bachchan meets fans with bullet proof shield on Sunday, Abhishek stands by his side amid threat
description: Amitabh Bachchan greeted fans outside his home last Sunday, maintaining the tradition despite a bomb threat. Security has been increased with a bullet-proof shield during these interactions, ensuring his safety. His son, Abhishek Bachchan, has been present to support his father throughout the process. Recently, Amitabh shared that he is focusing on his health and recovery, advising fans he requires more rest.

title: Ramayana: Ranbir links Musk flying car to Pushpaka
description: Ahead of Ramayana’s November 5 release, Ranbir Kapoor joked that India built a flying car 5,000 years ago, referring to the Pushpaka Vimana, the mythical flying palace seen in the trailer. Nitesh Tiwari directs the two-part film, with Sai Pallavi, Yash and Sunny Deol also starring.

title: Himesh to helm ‘blockbuster’ scripts
description: Himesh Reshammiya confirmed he plans to turn director, saying “100% you’ll see that,” and that his scripts are ready. He claimed his film’s music would earn Rs. 100 crore on release day. He also wants to become a superstar actor, predicting his 13th film will be a blockbuster.

title: RGV says blaming films for violence is misplaced
description: Ram Gopal Varma has responded to the backlash against films accused of promoting violence, likening the criticism to blaming the Ramayana for real-life crimes. His remarks come in light of a troubling incident involving a student attack in Andhra Pradesh, prompting heated debates about violent portrayals in the movie 'Animal.' Meanwhile, Varma continues to progress with new projects, including his upcoming film 'Police Company.'

title: Nani’s ‘Bloody Romeo’ shooting videos from Delhi go viral
description: Nani is filming 'Bloody Romeo' in Delhi, where videos from the shoot have surfaced online. The actor has undergone a makeover for the role, receiving a new hairstyle supervised by director Sujeeth. Nani will portray a character with dual identities, a chef and an outlaw, in this stylish action comedy. Although not all cast members have been confirmed, Preity Mukundhan and Prithviraj Sukumaran are reportedly involved.

title: Ram Charan unveils peacock-inspired pre-look poster of ‘RC17’
description: Ram Charan and director Sukumar have commenced the journey of their upcoming film 'RC17'. The film's pre-look poster showcases a peacock-inspired design featuring vibrant colors. Megastar Chiranjeevi participated in the pooja ceremony to formally launch the project. Many notable figures from the Telugu film industry attended the ceremony, highlighting the significance of this collaboration. Ram Charan expressed his excitement about reuniting with Sukumar for this special project.

title: In 2021, Kanye West bought his own Tadao Ando home, stripped it bare for a bunker, and now it's still under construction
description: Kanye West spent four days in a stunning Malibu mansion designed by Tadao Ando, setting up an office during his stay. Although he didn’t secure the property, it was eventually bought by Jay-Z and Beyoncé for an astounding $200 million. West later acquired a smaller Ando creation, but despite ambitious renovation plans, the home fell into abandonment due to his financial strains.

description: Rashmika Mandanna eagerly anticipates the debut of her film 'Mysaa' on November 27. Directed by Rawindra Pulle, she takes on the challenging role of a Gond woman. The film showcases a powerful father-daughter story intertwined with action, all set against the backdrop of tribal lands. The first single, 'O Mysaa Re', crafted by Jakes Bejoy, will drop on November 2, ensuring the film reaches audiences in multiple languages.
